sn5.4:1.2: Atha kho Vijayā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā || pa ||
sn5.4:1.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Vijayāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ || pa || samādhimhā cāvetu-kāmo yena Vijayā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Vijayaṃ bhikkhuniṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn5.4:3.1: Atha kho Vijayāya bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi || ||
sn5.4:3.2: Ko nu kho ayaṃ manusso vā amanusso vā gāthaṃ bhāsatīti || || 4.
sn5.4:3.3: Atha kho Vijayāya bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi || ||
sn5.4:3.4: Māro ayaṃ papimā || pa || gāthaṃ bhāsatīti || || 5.
sn5.4:3.5: Atha kho Vijayā bhikkhunī || Māro ayam pāpimā || iti viditvā Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gathāhi paccabhāsi || ||
sn5.4:7.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || jānāti maṃ Vijayā bhikkhunīti || dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || ||
